# Utility Functions

Helper functions defined in `R/utilities.R`.

Note: `plot_sensor_selection_map()` and `map_traffic_links()` moved to `R/diagnostics.R` and
are documented in [diagnostics.Rmd](diagnostics.Rmd).

---

## `expand_border()`

Repeatedly grows a seed set of link indices outward by `hops` adjacency steps and returns
only the newly reached border indices. Used by `partition_by_county()` to widen each county
partition across its borders.

```r
expand_border(seed_idx, adjacency_matrix, hops = 2)
```

### Returns

Integer vector of border indices reached within `hops` steps (seed indices excluded).

---

## `partition_by_county()`

Partitions a nationwide traffic-link dataset into per-county sub-datasets, each widened by
`hops` adjacency-matrix steps across county borders (via `expand_border()`), so
county-level sensor selection has spatial context beyond the county boundary.

```r
partition_by_county(data, adjacency_matrix, distances, hops = 2)
```

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `data` | data frame | Must have a `county` factor column |
| `adjacency_matrix` | sparse matrix | Square, matching `nrow(data)` |
| `distances` | numeric vector | Edge distances (upper-triangle order), from `fit_weighted_inla_model()$distances` |
| `hops` | integer | Hops to expand beyond the county boundary (default 2) |

### Returns

Named list (one element per county level), each with `$data`, `$adjacency_matrix`,
`$distances`, subsetted and reindexed consistently. Core rows are identified by
`$data$county == county_name`.

---

## `categorise_aadt()`

Categorises raw AADT values into ordered traffic-volume bands.

```r
categorise_aadt(
  x,
  breaks = c(0, 1000, 5000, 15000, 35000, Inf),
  labels = c("Very Low", "Low", "Medium", "High", "Very High")
)
```

### Returns

An ordered factor, same length as `x`.

---

## `summarise_sensor_selection()`

Computes summary statistics for a completed sensor selection: a tidy long data frame with
one row per covariate-level combination for all selected (non-derived, non-neighbour)
sensors, plus scalar fields.

```r
summarise_sensor_selection(
  selected_data,
  params      = list(),
  aadt_breaks = c(0, 1000, 5000, 15000, 35000, Inf),
  aadt_labels = c("Very Low", "Low", "Medium", "High", "Very High")
)
```

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `selected_data` | data frame | `selected_data_entries` from a Norway-level sensor-selection wrapper |
| `params` | named list | Call parameters recorded verbatim in the output |
| `aadt_breaks`, `aadt_labels` | — | Forwarded to `categorise_aadt()` |

### Returns

List: `counts_table` (long: `covariate`, `level`, `n`, `pct`), `n_selected`, `parameters`,
`enables_derivable_count` (or `NULL`), `total_derivable_links_enabled` (or `NULL`).

---

## `add_geometries()`

Attaches LineString geometries to a traffic-link data frame by left-joining
`data/directed_traffic_links_2024_simplified.geojson` (or the non-simplified fallback),
cached per session. Overrides `xdtkit::add_geometries()`, which uses an incompatible older
ID scheme.

```r
add_geometries(
  traffic_data,
  id_col       = "id",
  geojson_path = if (file.exists("data/directed_traffic_links_2024_simplified.geojson"))
                   "data/directed_traffic_links_2024_simplified.geojson"
                 else
                   "data/directed_traffic_links_2024.geojson"
)
```

### Returns

An `sf` data frame with LineString geometries attached.
